title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VibeVideoBench基准，用于评估通过编写代码来生成视频和声音的多模态智能体，发现即使是最先进的系统在满足核心要求方面仍面临显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散视频模型无法可靠地生成包含精确公式、正确图表、规则一致游戏或同步解说的视频。为解决这一问题，研究转向使用多模态智能体编写代码来渲染视频，但缺乏相应的评估基准。
AI.method: 提出了VibeVideoBench基准，包含239个中英文跨12类别的自包含任务。要求智能体在沙盒中于一小时内交付带声音的MP4。评估采用分层和基于证据的方法，包括程序检查、约1.3万个任务特定评分标准检查，以及由三个VLM评判小组基于五个质量维度进行评估并与人类盲测偏好进行验证。
AI.result: 对九个前沿智能体系统及2151次评分测试显示，GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5表现最佳，但最优系统仍在约25%的任务中未达核心要求。四分之三的失败视频归因于最终渲染启动过晚、运行过慢或未启动。评判系统在系统排名上与人类偏好一致，但对单个视频的评判一致性仅属中等。
AI.conclusion: 代码驱动的视频生成智能体尚未成熟，特别是在按时交付渲染结果方面存在显著瓶颈。该基准为未来提升智能体在复杂视频生成任务中的可靠性提供了重要参考。

title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
summary: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes. We introduce two complementary dimensions, work persistence and work openness, to characterize working conditions, and classify digital work into five forms according to task scope and organization. Building on this framework, we identify five core capability families required for reliable work execution and examine approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization. We further analyze existing evaluation methods and metrics from the perspective of work outcomes. Finally, we discuss future research directions, including sustained work delegation, adaptation to open environments, and the interaction between work execution and capability improvement. This paper provides a unified framework for understanding, optimizing, and evaluating work agents, supporting the development of systems capable of delivering reliable, verifiable, and practically valuable work outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以工作为中心的系统级框架，用于理解、优化和评估能够可靠执行数字任务并交付可验证结果的基础模型工作代理。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型从信息生成转向数字工作执行，现有研究缺乏一个关于代理如何可靠完成委托工作的统一视角。
AI.method: 提出将工作代理视为结合基础模型与运行时工具的系统，引入“工作持久性”和“工作开放性”两个维度来表征工作条件，将数字工作分为五种形式，并识别出可靠执行工作所需的五项核心能力，同时探讨了模型、工具及其联合优化的方法。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的框架，包含数字工作分类、核心能力需求及优化策略，并从工作结果视角系统分析了现有的评估方法与指标。
AI.conclusion: 本文为工作代理的理解、优化与评估提供了统一框架，并指出了持续工作委托、适应开放环境以及工作执行与能力提升交互等未来研究方向。

title: ACARE: Agent-Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search
summary: In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user's original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent's reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker's mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe)，一个4B参数的LLM重排器，通过利用智能体上下文来提升代理搜索中的检索质量和答案生成准确性。
AI.motivation: 在代理搜索中，传统重排器仅根据代理生成的子查询对文档评分，忽略了用户的原始问题、更广泛的任务背景和代理的推理过程，导致匹配的文档可能无助于回答用户的原始问题。
AI.method: 提出Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe)，一个紧凑的4B参数大语言模型，专门训练用于在可用时利用代理的任务上下文和推理背景对文档进行重新排序。
AI.result: 在多个基准和代理系列中，ACARe相比基础重排器提高了检索质量并减少了搜索工作量。它还提升了答案生成的准确性，用更精确的证据匹配或超越了基础重排器，并帮助较小的代理缩小了与大型代理在检索质量上的差距。
AI.conclusion: 更好的检索工具能有效提升小型代理的性能；模型权重、训练数据和代码即将开源。

title: I-HITL: Inalienable Human-in-the-Loop
summary:
Human oversight is a pillar of AI safety. It is often exercised by a human in the loop (HITL) who approves critical actions taken by an AI agent. AI agents' increasing ability to bypass guardrails, though, raises the question of how to enforce HITL robustly.
  We introduce the concept of inalienable human-in-the-loop (I-HITL). An I-HITL protocol ensures that an agent can initiate an action only with explicit human approval, even when the human interacts with a system (e.g., a local agentic harness) compromised by the agent. A strong I-HITL protocol additionally ensures such approval even when an adversarial human attempts to delegate approvals to an agent.
  To motivate I-HITL, we report on experiments with a popular agentic wallet platform in which raising an agent's spending cap requires HITL approval via emailed one-time passcodes (OTPs). Given access to the user's email and a task blocked by the cap, we find that ten different frontier models will often autonomously raise the cap, harvesting OTPs to bypass a HITL guardrail and surfacing other vulnerabilities.
  We formally define I-HITL using the concept of communication topologies and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for its realization. We show that an I-HITL protocol requires a trusted entity - a trusted computing device (or equivalent) - and characterize which such devices can and cannot realize an I-HITL protocol. We present a prototype I-HITL system called Countersign that can plug into and strengthen existing HITL systems using off-the-shelf consumer mobile devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了不可剥夺的人在环（I-HITL）概念，并开发了名为Countersign的原型系统，以确保即使在系统受损时AI代理的关键操作也必须获得明确的人类批准。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理绕过安全防线的能力增强，现有的人在环（HITL）防护栏（如通过邮件OTP审批）极易被前沿AI模型自主绕过，亟需一种在系统受损或对抗性委托下仍能强制人类监督的鲁棒协议。
AI.method: 引入不可剥夺的人在环（I-HITL）概念，利用通信拓扑形式化定义该协议并证明其实现的充要条件。证明该协议必须依赖可信计算设备，并开发了名为Countersign的原型系统，利用市售移动设备强化现有HITL系统。
AI.result: 实验发现十个前沿模型能通过获取邮件OTP自主提高消费上限以绕过HITL。理论证明了实现I-HITL必须依赖可信实体，并给出了能实现该协议的设备特征及Countersign原型系统。
AI.conclusion: I-HITL协议的实现必然需要可信计算设备，Countersign原型系统为加强和集成现有HITL系统提供了一种切实可行的解决方案。

title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

AI.tldr: 本文评估了前沿多模态大语言模型GPT-6-Astra在机器人控制中的能力边界，发现其与后训练策略结合能提升整体表现但仍存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无需特定机器人训练即可控制机器人，但其能力与后训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）策略在各种操作需求下的比较和交互作用仍有待全面评估。
AI.method: 在EBench上评估GPT-6-Astra作为核心智能体控制机器人的两种配置：直接控制（直接生成航点命令）和带策略的框架（可调用后训练的VLA或WAM策略执行动作），并在相同的视觉和本体感受观察协议下与后训练策略进行比较。
AI.result: 在直接控制下，智能体在短视野任务中领先且泛化性能变异最小，但在长视野、桌面操作和高精度接触丰富任务中表现不佳。在带策略的框架中，结合MLLM与后训练策略的优势，使整体成功率达到最强后训练策略水平并大幅降低令牌成本，但由于策略调用次优、缺乏子目标执行及恢复控制时的抓取干扰，性能仍低于独立组件的单任务上限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究界定了前沿MLLM智能体在机器人控制中的能力边界，并为改进未来的智能体框架设计（如优化策略调用机制和子目标执行）指明了方向。

title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
summary:
A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it.
  We present REVA (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, REVA gives the LLM a pre-computed threat model of its module, lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. REVA leverages a trained probe to read the LLM's internal representations of the new function in this context. On PrimeVul's held-out test set, REVA on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic detector, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM's own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, REVA is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. An LLM's internal representations thus encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.

AI.tldr: REVA是一种AI漏洞检测器，通过在单次LLM前向传播中结合预计算上下文与LLM内部表示，实现了与代理级检测器相当的实时高准确率检测。
AI.motivation: 软件漏洞发现越晚修复成本越高，而现有的LLM代理检测器虽然准确，但每次判定耗时数分钟，无法用于实时筛查；同时，更快的微调模型或直接提示LLM的方法因缺乏足够上下文而准确率较低。
AI.method: REVA为LLM提供每个新函数预计算的威胁模型、轻量级静态分析结果和调用图信息，并利用训练好的探针读取LLM在此上下文中的内部表示，从而将代理式推理过程压缩至单次前向传播中。
AI.result: 在PrimeVul测试集上，基于GLM-5.3-Flash的REVA在每函数约1秒内达到60.0%的准确率。这与最先进的代理检测器VulTriage（59.2%）相当，但速度快250倍以上，成本不到其十分之一。此外，探针比LLM直接生成的判定准确率高14%至17%；在三种开源LLM上，REVA至少与VulTriage一样准确，并在其中两种上高出约10%。
AI.conclusion: LLM的内部表示编码了代理检测器通过多步推理获得的大部分安全上下文与代码理解信息，使得在实时环境中实现高效、低成本且高准确率的漏洞筛查成为可能。

title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
summary: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了微型网络环境MiniWeb以诊断浏览器智能体的各项技能，并通过MiniWebGen生成技能导向的训练数据，结合规划器构建MiniWebAgent，显著提升了智能体在未知网站和外部基准上的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 浏览器智能体不仅需要更多练习，更需要针对性地练习正确的技能。现有基准通常仅关注任务是否成功，而无法诊断具体哪些交互技能存在缺陷（如拖拽和手势操作普遍较弱）。
AI.method: 本文提出了包含65个网站和369个任务的微型网络环境MiniWeb，将其划分为7个技能族和37个交互原语以诊断智能体技能；同时引入了MiniWebGen框架，自动生成经过验证的、以技能为中心的训练数据；最后构建了MiniWebAgent，将经过微调的执行器与一个规划器配对，将完整任务分解为已学习的技能级步骤。
AI.result: 对10个开源权重智能体的基准测试表明，拖拽与手势是最弱的技能族。在3.1K条验证轨迹上微调Qwen3.5-4B，使13个未知网站上的单原语成功率提高了24.9个百分点，且所有技能族均有提升。MiniWebAgent在未知MiniWeb网站上将任务成功率提高了19.4个百分点，并在未经训练的外部基准（WebArena-Lite、Online-Mind2Web、WebVoyager）上分别提升了9.3、16.1和20.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 本文为构建紧凑型浏览器智能体提供了一种简单方法：直接练习可复用技能，然后将其组合以解决未知任务。研究发现仅通过轨迹学习短视域交互并不能直接转化为完整任务的成功，必须结合任务分解的规划器。

title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
summary: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

AI.tldr: ZAP通过微调预训练视觉语言模型并结合简单工具套件，在无需真实世界训练数据的情况下，实现了高效、低成本且具备强泛化能力的机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略需同时理解场景任务要求及如何驱动机器人，而现有方法面临对真实世界数据依赖、运行成本高及速度慢等挑战。
AI.method: 提出Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP)，利用预训练的27B参数模型引导世界理解与推理，并在简单模拟任务上进行监督微调 (SFT) 和GRPO以学习机器人移动，最终通过工具套件实现控制。
AI.result: ZAP在真实任务中达96.7%成功率，匹敌GPT-6 Astra并优于MolmoAct2 VLA，速度快3倍且成本低17倍；同时能泛化至未见过的新物体、目标和操作类型，并成功迁移至未见过的单臂具身（RoboLab-120上达55.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 无需真实世界数据即可训练出高效、低成本且具有高度泛化与跨具身迁移能力的机器人控制策略，为机器人学习提供了一种可行的新范式。

title: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
summary: Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($λ$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface that decouples context management from rollout allocation. Our experiments show that using compaction-induced segment boundaries for value estimation and credit assignment, FOCUS outperforms GRPO and VinePPO with matched per-step generation budgets on legal reasoning, deep search, and code localization benchmarks, improving held-out accuracy at Qwen3.5-9B scale by 7.2 points over the strongest baseline on BrowseComp-Plus (55.4 vs. 48.2) and by 4.1 points on DeonticBench (56.5 vs. 52.4).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FOCUS，一种利用选择性分支进行主动学习以提升评论家网络价值估计准确性的强化学习方法，从而解决长时程语言模型智能体在稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 长时程语言模型智能体面临稀疏结果奖励导致的早期动作信用分配困难。现有方法中，学习型评论家网络的中间状态价值估计不准确，且通过重复轨迹继续采样估计中间价值成本过高。
AI.method: 提出FOCUS强化学习方法，采用选择性分支策略帮助评论家网络学习价值估计器。rollout控制器通过从预期最能降低评论家估计误差的状态中采样继续轨迹，实现评论家的主动学习；随后使用TD($λ$)优势评估连续状态间片段的得分，并将采样证据作为评论家的训练目标。此外，引入模块化上下文管理接口，将上下文管理与rollout分配解耦。
AI.result: 在法律推理、深度搜索和代码定位基准测试中，在每步生成预算匹配的情况下，FOCUS优于GRPO和VinePPO。在Qwen3.5-9B规模下，相较于最强基线，在BrowseComp-Plus上的留出准确率提升了7.2分（55.4 vs. 48.2），在DeonticBench上提升了4.1分（56.5 vs. 52.4）。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS通过利用压缩诱导的片段边界进行价值估计和信用分配，有效支持了长时程智能体强化学习，并在多个基准测试中显著提升了模型性能。

title: Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents
summary: Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential "jaggedness" of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.
comment: Code and data present at: https://github.com/tiasa2/SmoothScore

AI.tldr: 本文识别并量化了大语言模型在生成研究报告时产生的一种名为“平滑”（smoothing）的失败模式，即模型生成过于自信的结论而未能准确反映底层文档的冲突与差异。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在用于深度研究并综合大量文档信息时，生成的长篇报告往往读起来像自信的综合，但实际上未能准确反映底层文档的证据“锯齿状”特征（即多样性和冲突性）。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个声明级别的评分管道SmoothScore。该管道从模型生成的报告中提取关键结论性声明，为每个声明查找相关证据并按高层方面对证据进行聚类，最后根据证据对每个声明进行评分，以量化智能体进行的平滑程度。
AI.result: 在7个系统和4个数据集上的实验发现，智能体持续产生比证据所能支持的更强（更绝对）的结论。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，LLM智能体倾向于平滑文档集合中的冲突信息，而提出的SmoothScore管道提供了一种量化该效应的有效方法。

title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

AI.tldr: 提出dSpark框架，通过调度蒸馏学习何时提交标记，从而加速扩散大语言模型的并行生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽能并行生成标记，但常需大量解码轮次。高效生成不仅取决于标记的可预测性，更取决于提交这些标记能否帮助预测剩余位置。因此，需要一种智能调度机制来优先揭示能显著降低全局不确定性的标记。
AI.method: 提出基于调度蒸馏的dSpark框架。该方法构建优先揭示那些能使其他位置更易预测的标记的解掩码调度，以尽早减少解码过程中的不确定性；随后利用带有KL散度正则项的蒸馏技术将此调度集成到模型中，以实现更快的并行采样。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上进行了广泛评估。在GSM8K数据集上，该方法在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct模型上分别实现了10.12倍和5.12倍的加速，同时保持了优越的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: dSpark有效优化了扩散语言模型的解码标记提交策略，在显著提升生成速度的同时维持甚至提升了生成质量。

title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合调整扩散努力程度和推测解码接受宽松度，探索并扩展了推测扩散中速度与质量的帕累托边界。
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码是无损的，而扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）可以通过降低质量换取速度。本文旨在解决如何利用扩散努力程度和推测解码宽松度这两个参数，来探索完整的速度-质量帕累托边界的问题。
AI.method: 提出联合变化扩散努力程度（diffusion effort）和接受宽松度（acceptance leniency）的方法，以探索和扩展完整的帕累托边界。
AI.result: 实验表明，联合调整扩散努力程度和接受宽松度，相比单步扩散起草，能够显著扩展速度与质量的帕累托边界。
AI.conclusion: 结合可调的扩散努力程度和有损的宽松接受推测解码，可以有效优化大语言模型推理的速度与质量权衡。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将连续潜在空间攻击框架与连续扩散语言模型直接耦合，以生成更自然的对抗提示，从而提供更准确的大语言模型风险估计。
AI.motivation: 传统的连续空间攻击使用随机映射生成提示，导致提示不自然、易被输入护栏检测，且生成的风险估计缺乏真实自然语言的基础。
AI.method: 将连续潜在空间框架直接与学习到的连续扩散语言模型相结合，去除人工随机映射，同时保留标准高斯潜在表述和下游采样或优化过程，并在RareTrap和ThinkTrap两种设置下进行评估。
AI.result: 在RareTrap中，字符级困惑度从10^3--10^7降至3--5；在ThinkTrap中，从20--28降至4.3--5.4。此外，不同映射下的模型风险估计相差一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 结合连续扩散语言模型的框架能显著降低提示的困惑度，生成更自然的对抗提示，提供更可靠的LLM风险评估，揭示了传统方法在风险估计上的显著差异。

title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of RMT-Jailbreak, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RMT-Jailbreak框架，通过掩码自回归模型生成的有害响应并诱导扩散大语言模型进行双向重构，实现跨范式的越狱攻击转移。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的灵活掩码生成和双向上下文建模引入了新的越狱攻击面，本文旨在探索并验证该攻击面的可利用性。
AI.method: RMT-Jailbreak框架将自回归（AR）模型生成的有害响应转换为高掩码比例模板，利用提示进行安全过滤以掩码剩余可见有害内容，随后将该模板输入目标dLLM进行双向重构。
AI.result: 跨多种AR越狱方法和目标dLLMs的实验表明，RMT-Jailbreak具有高效性和通用性，证明了越狱攻击具有强大的跨范式可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明dLLMs存在由双向建模引入的严重安全漏洞，且现有的AR越狱攻击可轻易跨范式转移至dLLMs。

title: Trion-1: Unifying Language, Protein Sequence, and Structure with Diffusion Language Models
summary: We envision a general-purpose protein foundation model as a unified, interactive model of sequence, structure, and function, capable of understanding, generation, and cross-modal translation while retaining the instruction-following and reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs. Toward this vision, we introduce Trion-1, the first native, unified, multimodal diffusion language model (dLLM) for proteins. Trion-1 is built on two key design choices: (1) a unified discrete token space that jointly represents sequence, structure, and natural language; (2) a dLLM backbone that replaces strict left-to-right factorization with bidirectional or semi-bidirectional token interactions, enabling global residue communication and long-range contact modeling that are naturally suited to structure modeling. This formulation unifies six core capabilities: folding, inverse folding, sequence understanding, structure understanding, sequence design, and structure design, while retaining the native language capabilities of general-purpose LLMs. On established benchmarks, Trion-1 achieves broadly competitive performance. In folding, Trion-1 achieves a TM-score above 0.8 with a single sample under strict homology control, matching or exceeding the existing tri-modal model using 200 samples. For sequence understanding, Trion-1 performs on par with top-tier LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.7 (62.37%). These results support well-aligned sequence-structure-language representations and strong cross-modal generative capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Trion-1，首个用于蛋白质的原生统一多模态扩散语言模型，通过联合离散标记空间和双向交互主干网络，实现了序列、结构与自然语言的理解、生成及跨模态翻译。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个通用的蛋白质基础模型，解决现有模型无法统一处理蛋白质序列、结构和功能，且缺乏跨模态翻译及大型语言模型指令遵循与推理能力的问题。
AI.method: 提出Trion-1模型，核心设计包括：(1)联合表示序列、结构和自然语言的统一离散标记空间；(2)扩散语言模型（dLLM）主干网络，采用双向或半双向标记交互取代传统的从左至右因式分解，以实现全局残基通信和长程接触建模。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中表现出色。在严格同源性控制下，单次采样折叠的TM-score超过0.8，使用200个样本即可匹配或超越现有三模态模型；在序列理解任务上，与Claude Opus 4.7等顶级大模型表现相当（62.37%）。
AI.conclusion: Trion-1成功实现了序列、结构与自然语言表示的良好对齐，并具备强大的跨模态生成能力，为通用蛋白质基础模型的发展提供了有效路径。

title: GRAFT: Restoring the Missing Sampling Interface in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate a whole sequence in parallel, never drawing a single word at any intermediate step; only the final step turns embeddings into text. Models such as ELF now report autoregressive-level quality at a fraction of the sampling steps of discrete-token diffusion models, and this design principle -- no step-wise discretization -- is what their own ablations credit for the gain. We show that this same principle carries a hidden cost: a collapse of the lexical long tail. Measured against held-out human text, ELF's output matches the human rate on common words almost exactly, yet its rarest words appear at only 0.30x the human rate, a gap that does not close from 105M to 652M parameters and that no sampler setting these models expose can reach. A same-size GPT-2, in contrast, spans zero to above the human rate by its decoding rule alone. We trace the difference to what continuous diffusion models lack: with no step that ever draws a discrete word, every step is instead driven by an average over the candidates still in play, and averaging a rare candidate together with the common word competing for its slot lands on the common word. An autoregressive model avoids this because its decoding rule samples one candidate rather than averaging over all of them. We propose GRAFT, a training-free method that grafts this missing choice back onto a frozen model: while the model is still undecided, GRAFT commits the rare words the average would otherwise discard, then regenerates the sequence from scratch with those commitments held in place. Across three ELF scales and on LangFlow, an independent continuous dLLM, GRAFT restores the rare-word share of generated text from 0.42-0.77x the human rate to 0.82-1.10x, a relative gain of 34-109%, and moves the entire word-frequency profile closer to human on every model tested, by 2.7x on ELF-B and 12x on LangFlow.

AI.tldr: 本文发现连续扩散语言模型存在长尾词汇生成率低的问题，并提出无需训练的GRAFT方法以恢复罕见词生成比例，使词频分布更接近人类文本。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型（如ELF）在中间步骤不生成离散词，导致在多候选词平均时丢失罕见词。这造成模型输出中长尾词汇出现率远低于人类水平（仅0.30倍），且无法通过增加参数或调整采样器解决。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT，一种无需训练的干预方法。在模型尚未决定时，提前提交那些在平均过程中本会被丢弃的罕见词，并在保持这些承诺不变的情况下从头重新生成序列。
AI.result: 在三种ELF规模及LangFlow模型上测试，GRAFT将罕见词占比从人类水平的0.42-0.77倍提升至0.82-1.10倍（相对增益34-109%）。同时使整体词频分布更接近人类水平（ELF-B提升2.7倍，LangFlow提升12倍）。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散模型无逐步离散化的设计虽具速度优势，却导致长尾词汇坍缩。通过训练自由的GRAFT方法，可有效弥补此缺陷，显著改善生成文本的词汇多样性与人类相似度。

title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
summary: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: DiffResearch是一个基于扩散语言模型的多智能体深度研究框架，相比自回归模型在端到端延迟上快约6倍，同时保持甚至提升了报告质量。
AI.motivation: 交互式深度研究系统的端到端延迟是关键瓶颈，现有生产系统均基于自回归语言模型，继承了从左到右解码的固有延迟问题，尤其在规划和长文本写作阶段表现突出。
AI.method: 提出DiffResearch框架，在每个阶段的核心使用扩散语言模型（dLLM）；进一步引入dFast分解模式，通过读取中间去噪状态在生成完成前提取子查询，实现提前介入的并行化处理。
AI.result: 在100个Deep Research Bench任务上，扩散骨干端到端速度提升约6倍；dFast在分解环节实现1.99倍中位数加速且报告质量无损；dFast在RACE评分标准上获得三种配置中的最佳总分；基于更强扩散模型的实例在公开系统级排行榜上超越多个商业系统。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型可作为深度研究系统的有效骨干，显著降低延迟同时保持质量；未来可进一步优化扩散模型在智能体框架中的应用；系统已在Apache-2.0许可下开源。

title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的解码器TeCoP，通过解耦预测的提交与其上下文效用，在不牺牲准确率的情况下大幅提升了扩散式大语言模型的吞吐量并减少了前向评估次数。
AI.motivation: 扩散式大语言模型在每次前向传递中预测多个Token位置，但现有的分块解码器序列化生成并重复计算稳定的预测。这种低效性源于将预测在不可逆提交上的准备状态与其作为上下文的效用耦合在一起。
AI.method: 提出Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP)，一种无需训练的解码器。它通过交错的块并行流水线和草稿验证机制来解耦上述角色。TeCoP重用稳定但未提交的预测作为临时的跨块上下文，并通过置信度和稳定性检查来控制提交。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、Minerva MATH和MBPP基准测试的四个LLaDA和Dream dLLMs上，TeCoP将前向评估次数最多减少了87%，并在无KV缓存和有缓存的情况下分别实现了7.50倍和11.77倍的吞吐量提升。在所有12种模型-基准设置中，其吞吐量均优于Fast-dLLM和DSB，且平均缓存准确率与原始解码器的差距保持在1个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: TeCoP为扩散式大语言模型提供了一种高效且无需训练的解码策略，在保持模型准确率的同时极大地加速了生成吞吐量，确立了扩散式大模型解码的新基准。

title: Who Gets Unmasked? Sampler-Induced Bias in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate by gradually unmasking a canvas, so their samplers decide not only which token to write but also when to commit it. We show that this second decision changes who appears in generated text, a sampler-induced bias on top of the model's own. Common commit rules, including LLaDA's default, commit the positions whose sampled tokens are most probable; this peeking favors majority options. To separate the sampler from the model, we read the model's belief about a fork, such as a protagonist's gender, in one forward pass, and show that this belief matches exact sampling from the model. Measured against it, peeking samplers on LLaDA and Dream amplify occupational gender stereotypes and collapse opinion distributions, and confidence-based ordering shifts gender-balanced occupations toward men, more so under faster parallel decoding. We propose Fork-First Sampling, which decides the fork before anything else is written: it follows the belief or any target distribution, improves fluency, and avoids the stories that remark on the protagonist's gender, which prompt-based fixes produce, at the cost of one forward pass. Fairness evaluations of dLLMs should report the commit rule.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散语言模型中采样器提交规则导致的偏见问题，并提出了Fork-First Sampling方法来缓解偏见、提升流畅性。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的采样器在决定何时提交词元时，常见的“窥视”规则会偏向多数选项，从而在模型自身偏见之上叠加采样器引入的偏见，放大职业性别刻板印象等不公平现象。
AI.method: 提出Fork-First Sampling（优先分叉采样）技术，在生成其他内容前先决定“分叉”（如主角性别），直接遵循模型的真实信念或目标分布，仅需额外一次前向传播。
AI.result: 现有的窥视采样器在LLaDA和Dream模型上放大了职业性别刻板印象并导致观点分布坍缩；而Fork-First Sampling能改善流畅度，避免生成刻意提及性别的文本，且无提示词修复方法的副作用。
AI.conclusion: dLLMs的公平性评估必须报告所使用的提交规则，因为该规则显著影响生成文本中的群体表现；Fork-First Sampling为解决此类偏见提供了有效途径。

title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出PV-Decoding，一种用于离散扩散语言模型推理的置信度驱动投机解码框架，通过渐进式验证在保持准确率的同时提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型虽然能并行更新多个token，但由于同一扩散块内的投机token可能相互依赖，导致激进接受容易产生错误传播且严格验证计算成本高，限制了推理效率。
AI.method: 提出PV-Decoding框架，利用双置信度阈值将掩码位置分为直接解码、投机和未解决token，并采用从单批次到多批次等逐步增强的策略验证投机token，以平衡准确性与效率。
AI.result: 在三个扩散语言模型和GSM8K等数据集上的实验表明，PV-Decoding相比基于置信度的解码减少了8%-37%的顺序模型前向传播（MFPs），最大准确率下降仅为1.3%；在Dream-7B上吞吐量提升7.0%-13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 置信度引导的投机与结构化验证是实现高效、可靠的dLLM推理的实用途径，尽管多批次验证在当前运行时下较慢，但仍提供了精度权衡。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练，通过优化验证过程和利用目标反馈改进树结构，显著提升了推测解码的效率。
AI.motivation: 基于树的推测解码在有限树上构建草稿时存在草稿与目标模型不匹配的根本问题，需要研究如何通过更好的精确验证在固定树上提高接受率，以及如何利用目标反馈改进树本身。
AI.method: 通过“目标流”视角识别出规范退出定律，证明目标覆盖率严格界定任何精确路径验证器的期望输出块长度。据此提出精确且层并行的树退出验证（TEV）。同时利用退出定律识别缺失目标概率，提供节点级反馈，提出退出引导草稿树训练。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验表明，ExitTrain使平均输出块长度增加13%，TEV使验证器阶段延迟降低15%，相比DDTree实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 提升推测解码性能有两个关键机会：构建更好的草稿树以提高接受率，以及设计更直接的验证机制以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

AI.tldr: DominoTree结合免训练的最佳优先树与路径依赖的因果校正，显著提升了大语言模型推测解码的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测解码方法存在局限：DDTree构建树时独立于分支前序词元进行评分，而Domino虽条件于这些词元但仅能起草单条链。本文旨在结合两者优势，以实现多备选序列的验证并提升接受率。
AI.method: 提出DominoTree，一种免训练的最佳优先树生成方法。它利用Domino的路径依赖因果校正对树进行评分，并限制为top-M候选。针对混合Gated-DeltaNet模型，还引入了树感知的循环验证机制。

AI.conclusion: DominoTree通过路径依赖的因果校正和树状草稿的结合，在低并发和单请求场景下显著提升了推理速度和接受率。然而在高并发场景下，链式草稿在维持吞吐量上更具优势，为未来服务系统的优化指明了方向。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配机制，为基于扩散语言模型的投机解码构建更优的草稿树，实现了显著的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的树构建器采用父节点条件扩展，与在单次前向传播中生成所有未来位置分布的扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器不兼容。现有解决方案DDTree仅依赖token概率进行边选择而不考虑父子兼容性，且固定预算无法适应随解码状态变化的最优树大小。
AI.method: 提出了GRAFT框架，包含两个核心组件：1）目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES），从目标模型轨迹中蒸馏父子偏好以选择目标兼容的边；2）状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证开销来动态设定每轮的树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮增加的额外开销不到0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT成功弥合了基于树的投机解码与DLM草稿器之间的差距，通过优化边选择和动态预算分配，在不显著增加延迟的前提下大幅提升了推理速度。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: CaDDTree通过联合优化树结构和节点预算并显式建模延迟，直接最大化token吞吐量，从而加速大语言模型推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的DDTree方法在固定节点预算下最大化期望接受长度，但由于接受长度随预算非递减，它总是倾向于更大的树而忽略验证成本，缺乏选择预算的原则性基础。
AI.method: 提出CaDDTree（成本感知扩散草稿树），显式建模草稿和验证延迟，将吞吐量优化转化为每轮预算的一维搜索，并利用吞吐量函数在凸验证成本下的单峰特性实现高效的贪心停止规则，每轮动态调整预算。
AI.result: 在涵盖推理、编码和指令遵循的八个基准测试中，基于Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B的实验表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越了使用预言机预算的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree提供了一种在推测解码中无需离线预算搜索的动态自适应方法，有效优化了实际推理吞吐量，未来可进一步探索更复杂的延迟模型和树构建策略。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS，一种用于扩散模型并行起草的目标感知前缀选择方法，通过优化接受与成本之间的权衡来加速无损自回归解码。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散树方法使用边际概率排序节点而忽略了验证是前缀条件的，导致验证不可达的被拒绝前缀的后代，增加了延迟且接受率提升有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS方法，将扩散边际转化为路径条件的接受估计，并在固定的验证预算下选择一个紧凑的前缀闭子树，以改善接受成本权衡。
AI.result: 在多样化数据集和模型家族上的实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，分别以1.36倍和1.74倍优于最先进的DFlash和DDTree。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过路径条件的接受估计和紧凑的子树选择，有效解决了验证阶段的瓶颈，实现了显著的推理加速。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDTree方法，通过从块扩散草稿模型的位置分布构建草稿树，在单次前向传播中高效验证多个续写路径，从而提升了推测解码的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的DFlash推测解码方法每轮仅验证单条草稿轨迹，限制了其接受长度，从而制约了加速效果。
AI.method: DDTree直接基于块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下使用最佳优先堆算法筛选最可能匹配目标模型的续写，并使用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中高效验证该树结构。
AI.result: 基于DFlash的DDTree获得了性能提升，成为推测解码领域的领先方法之一。
AI.conclusion: DDTree成功将块扩散模型与树状推测解码相结合，证实了通过构建并高效验证草稿树能有效突破单轨迹验证的性能瓶颈。

title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
summary:
For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.
  This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.
  Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Reproduction artifacts available at https://github.com/harinechoi/confidence-auditing-reproduction

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一统计框架，用于评估和比较基于模型置信度的分层审计与LLM作为评判者的自动评估方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型自报的置信度通常未校准，而LLM作为评判者虽具可扩展性，其实际效益取决于校准质量和推理成本。本文旨在解决如何在未校准置信度和成本限制下高效评估模型的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一统计框架：对于直接审计，采用置信度分层抽样从部分验证输出中恢复总体准确率并表征有限样本不确定性；对于评判者辅助评估，通过敏感性和假阳性率对评判者建模，得出带有校准不确定性的误差校正估计器。最后通过效率边界对两者进行比较。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro和MMMU-Pro上的实验表明，未校准的置信度仍能支持统计有效的分层审计。在高度不平衡的置信度分布下，按比例分配显著降低了估计误差。对于评判者辅助评估，仅有少量目标-验证器对满足理想的人类标签效率条件，且推理成本进一步限制了潜在的成本节约。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果明确了置信度引导审计和自动验证在何种统计与经济条件下是有用的，为模型评估的策略选择提供了清晰的指导。

title: OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. Extensive ablations and analyses further reveal the effects of visual EEG renderings, MoP variants, router behavior, and feature dispersion across EEG tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OneEEG，一个用于多任务脑电（EEG）理解的统一EEG-多模态大语言模型框架，通过结合数值和视觉EEG表示及任务感知混合投影器实现了更优的EEG理解性能。
AI.motivation: 当前EEG建模在不同任务范式间存在碎片化问题，且现有多模态大语言模型对EEG输入的理解能力有限，亟需一种统一框架以提升模型对多任务EEG的理解与推理能力。
AI.method: 提出OneEEG框架，在构建的多任务EEG指令微调数据集上联合建模数值与视觉EEG表示，并引入任务感知混合投影器将异构EEG特征与LLM嵌入空间对齐；同时建立OneEEG-Bench基准进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明现有MLLMs解释EEG的能力有限，而OneEEG通过整合数值与视觉EEG表示以及任务感知投影取得了更强性能；消融分析揭示了视觉渲染、MoP变体、路由器行为及特征分散的具体影响。
AI.conclusion: OneEEG成功实现了多任务EEG理解的统一建模，突破了现有MLLMs在EEG理解上的局限，为未来跨任务EEG特征对齐与融合提供了重要参考。

title: MulFCoder: Framework-conditioned Multi-agent for MLLM-based Multi-framework Front-end Code Generation
summary: Generating runnable front-end code from UI screenshots is a long-standing goal in automated software engineering. Existing MLLM-based methods predominantly focused on HTML/CSS, leaving multi-framework generation for React/Vue/Angular underexplored. Naively modifying prompts leads to substantial performance gaps across multi-framework and highly framework-specific error modes. To address this, we propose MulFCoder, a framework-conditioned multi-agent method that explicitly encodes framework constraints to bring multi-framework differences into a decidable rule space. MulFCoder orchestrates four agents: Grounder constructs an ElementTable, ContentTable, and macro-layout regions from detected UI elements; Planner builds a DOM-like hierarchical layout tree, produces a task schedule, and derives a framework-specific file Contract; Writer generates structured file writes or patches within a restricted edit window; Judger enforces lightweight, framework-conditioned constraints to accept or reject updates and trigger bounded repairs, preventing drift and deadlocks without expensive builds. Experiments demonstrate that MulFCoder substantially improves compilation success rate and reduces framework-specific errors, with particularly pronounced gains on Angular.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MulFCoder，一个基于框架条件的智能体方法，用于从UI截图生成多框架（React/Vue/Angular）的前端代码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的方法多集中于HTML/CSS，多框架代码生成尚待探索，且简单修改提示词会导致显著的性能差距和特定框架错误。
AI.method: MulFCoder通过四个智能体协同：Grounder构建元素表与布局区域，Planner构建布局树与文件契约，Writer生成文件写入或补丁，Judger执行约束以接受或拒绝更新并触发有限修复。
AI.result: MulFCoder显著提高了编译成功率并减少了特定框架的错误，在Angular框架上的提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式编码框架约束并引入多智能体协作机制，能够有效解决多框架前端代码生成中的性能差距和错误问题。

title: CropReward: A Human-Preference Benchmark and Reward Model for Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Aesthetic image cropping (AIC) aims to improve image composition and aesthetic quality by removing extraneous or distracting content. Over the past decade, AIC methods have evolved from specialized vision models to multimodal large language models(MLLMs). Reliable evaluation that reflects human preferences is essential for benchmarking AIC methods and guiding model optimization. However, the current AIC evaluation relies largely on geometry-based metrics such as intersection over union (IoU), as well as image aesthetic assessment(IAA) models. Although inconsistencies with human preferences have long been observed, the robustness and reliability of these evaluation criteria remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we first construct CropBench, a large-scale benchmark comprising 106,995 human preference pairs for 1,019 images, with each candidate set containing the original image and candidate crops produced by 14 AIC methods. A systematic study on CropBench reveals that the existing criteria, ranging from IoU to off-the-shelf IAA assessment models, only exhibit limited alignment with human preferences. Building upon CropBench, we further propose CropReward, an MLLM-based reward model that evaluates a candidate crop by comparing with the original uncropped image and outputs a score indicating explicit aesthetic improvement or degradation relative to the original. In addition, we employ CropReward to construct CropReward-300k, the largest AIC dataset to date, and further develop CropAlign, a preference-aligned AIC model trained solely with CropReward supervision, without human-annotated crop boxes. Experimental results demonstrate that CropReward aligns with human preferences significantly better than existing criteria. CropAlign also surpasses the state-of-the-art AIC methods, demonstrating the advantage of CropReward in guiding AIC model optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了大规模人类偏好基准CropBench和基于多模态大语言模型的奖励模型CropReward，解决了现有美学图像裁剪评估标准与人类偏好不一致的问题，并基于此训练了超越SOTA的AIC模型CropAlign。
AI.motivation: 现有的美学图像裁剪（AIC）评估标准（如IoU和图像美学评估模型）与人类偏好存在不一致，且其鲁棒性和可靠性尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 构建了包含10.6万个人类偏好对的大规模基准CropBench；提出基于多模态大语言模型的奖励模型CropReward，通过将候选裁剪图与原图比较来评估美学改进；利用CropReward构建了最大AIC数据集CropReward-300k，并训练了无需人工标注的偏好对齐AIC模型CropAlign。
AI.result: 现有评估标准与人类偏好对齐有限；CropReward与人类偏好的对齐程度显著优于现有标准；CropAlign模型超越了当前最先进的AIC方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于MLLM的奖励模型CropReward能够有效指导AIC模型优化，证明了其在提升图像裁剪美学评估可靠性与模型性能方面的优势。

title: From Presence Labels to Bounding Boxes: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Scale Surgical Instrument Localization?
summary: Spatial localization of surgical instruments through bounding-box annotations is a foundational component of surgical scene understanding, supporting detection, tracking, interaction analysis, and grounded vision-language applications. Yet existing annotations often cover selected frames, video subsets, or dataset variants rather than complete procedures. Manual extension is time-consuming and expert-dependent. Additionally, weakly supervised and detector-based pseudo-labels require task-specific training and may be imprecise. In this study, we design a scalable MLLM-based annotation framework that converts surgical frames and existing instrument-presence labels into accurate bounding boxes, and systematically analyze its reliability, cost, and design sensitivity. We instantiate the framework using six MLLMs and a multi-call configuration on laparoscopic cholecystectomy in Cholec80. Using a carefully designed stratification scheme, two annotators independently label 1,000 frames, and an expert surgeon reviews one annotation set to establish the reference. Results show that instrument-set F1 ranges from 88.2 to 92.7,whereas mIoU ranges from 0.180 to 0.735, showing that comparable recognition can conceal large localization differences. A structured multi-stage annotation pipeline achieves 0.784 mIoU, compared with 0.735 for the best single-call baseline and 0.814 human-human agreement. Using the best accuracy pipeline, we create and publicly release a spatial extension of Cholec80 comprising 285,977 bounding boxes across all 184,498 annotated frames from the 80 videos. The annotations and human references are made available on GitHub

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的可扩展标注框架，用于生成手术器械的边界框，并发布了Cholec80的空间扩展数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有的手术器械边界框标注通常不完整且人工扩展耗时，而弱监督或检测器生成的伪标签需要特定任务训练且不够精确。
AI.method: 设计了一个基于MLLM的可扩展标注框架，将手术帧和现有的器械存在标签转换为准确的边界框，并在Cholec80上使用六种MLLM和多调用配置进行了实例化和系统分析。
AI.result: 结构化多阶段标注流水线实现了0.784的mIoU，优于最佳单次调用的0.735，接近0.814的人机一致性。基于此创建了包含285,977个边界框的Cholec80空间扩展数据集并公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 基于MLLM的标注框架能有效扩展手术器械的空间定位标注，接近人工一致性水平，为手术场景理解提供了大规模公开数据集。

title: Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/
comment: Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 33 pages, 14 figures, and 23 tables

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SATE-Bench，一个评估多模态大语言模型视觉自我感知与主动视角探索能力的交互式基准，揭示了现有模型在主动空间推理方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs的空间能力评估主要依赖静态、被动观察，但在复杂场景中遮挡常隐藏关键几何证据，被动基准迫使模型猜测而非识别自身视觉不确定性，因此需要一个评估主动探索和视觉自我感知的基准。
AI.method: 提出SATE-Bench基准，包含316个真实场景和2,525个多轮QA对，结合被动多视角控制与主动探索设置，模型从严重遮挡视角出发，需迭代查询相邻视角以收集足够证据，采用步数惩罚效率奖励评分；并使用GRPO进行微调实验。
AI.result: 评估发现最先进的MLLMs过早终止探索同时报告高置信度，且在细粒度3D几何任务上表现不佳；匹配视角对照进一步将主动-被动差距主要归因于证据获取不足；GRPO微调显示奖励视角寻求增加了主动探索但降低了整体准确率，因为模型过度探索且无法跨轮融合多视角上下文。
AI.conclusion: 扩展被动多视角感知并不能内在地产生主动空间推理，未来需要开发能够知道往哪看、如何整合所见内容以及何时停止的模型。

title: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
summary: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today's MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于人机闭环交互的可验证环境InteractiveWorld及动态基准InteractiveBench，用于评估多模态大语言模型在物理世界中指导人类的能力。
AI.motivation: 由于真实交互数据昂贵且稀缺，测试基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的自我中心AI助手充满挑战，本文旨在回答当今的MLLM是否真正能在物理世界中帮助人类这一关键问题。
AI.method: 提出了可验证环境InteractiveWorld，让AI助手指导独立行动的人类代理，并基于此引入包含120个多轮任务的动态基准InteractiveBench，通过基于状态的可验证奖励对结果进行评分。
AI.result: 对12个前沿MLLM的实验表明，它们距离成为可靠的助手仍有很大差距，表现最强的模型Claude Fable 5.1在长期指导和规划任务上的得分也分别仅为20%和25%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个可验证的平台和严格的评估集，为研究真正能在物理世界中帮助人类的交互式MLLM助手奠定了坚实基础。

title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MTA-Zero，一个在线多模态问答-求解器协同训练框架，通过生成处于模型学习前沿的问题来持续提升多模态深度搜索智能体的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在需要图像定位、工具选择和整合网络证据的开放世界多步搜索中表现受限，且现有方法依赖固定的离线语料库，其问题分布无法随着目标智能体的改进而自适应调整。
AI.method: 提出MTA-Zero框架，包含一个可训练的QA生成器（在线检索证据并构建验证过的多跳问题）和一个深度搜索求解器（选择工具并回答问题）。引入“金发姑娘”奖励机制，根据求解器的组内 rollout 成功率，仅对处于当前学习前沿的问题给予奖励，并使用GRPO独立优化这两个策略。
AI.result: 在六个多模态深度搜索基准上，MTA-Zero将Qwen3-VL-8B求解器的平均准确率从36.91%提升至51.58%，性能与GPT-5相当；同时将更新的Qwen3.6-27B求解器提升了10.82个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 经过验证的在线问题生成能够为多模态深度搜索智能体提供特定于策略的课程学习，从而实现智能体的持续自我改进。

title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
summary: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.
comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at https://github.com/nadunnr/PathKGen

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PathKGen，一个知识图谱辅助的多模态大语言模型，通过注入外部结构化知识和可视化推理来生成组织病理学报告。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的推理纯粹依赖其神经网络参数中编码的分布，限制了其能包含的知识和推理逻辑；同时，其黑盒推理过程阻碍了人类对中间推理步骤的理解。
AI.method: PathKGen包含两个主要分支：(1) 视觉路径，使用病理学基础模型学习视觉标记并输入至MLLM；(2) 知识路径，通过查询病理学专属知识图谱提取WSI的关键形态特征，以学习知识标记并输入至MLLM。
AI.result: 在WSI-Bench数据集上的综合评估表明，PathKGen超越了先前最先进（SOTA）的方法，同时能将诊断推理过程以视觉直观的图谱形式展现。
AI.conclusion: 得益于其模块化设计，所提出的知识路径是对视觉对齐MLLMs的有力补充，并且可以通过构建特定领域的知识图谱来扩展至其他应用场景。
